statement.p: Use the Fundamental Theorem to determine the value of b if the area under the graph of f(x) = 7 x between x = 1 and x = b is equal to 168. Assume b>1.

static.solution: f(x) = 7 x between x=1 and x = b is given by \int_1^b (7 x) dx. Using the Fundamental Theorem to evaluate the integral: \hbox{Area } = \frac{7}{2} x^2 \bigg|_1^b = \frac{7}{2} b^2 - \frac{7}{2}. Since the area is 168, we have \frac{7}{2} b^2 - \frac{7}{2} = 168, so \frac{7}{2} b^2 = \frac{343}{2}, and thus b^2 = 49,\quad\hbox{or}\quad b = \pm 7. Since b is larger than 1, we have b = 7.
